comparison.objective: Position three microphone stands according to the acoustic 3:1 spacing rule; candidate removes and recovers four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Relational spatial placement, including a stand handoff, versus recessed coaxial tool alignment, simultaneous mandrel stabilization and hammering, fracture-force control, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Each stand within 6 cm of its singer and pairwise spacing at least three times the larger source distance versus four valid fractures with containment and no insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both use bimanual manipulation, but the record tests layout reasoning rather than impact-mediated finishing of threaded inserts. No spec versions are available.
